title: 🎥 The Man Who Challenged Europe by Printing Euros
text:
🎥 The Man Who Challenged Europe by Printing Euros"

"🔹 Italian police discovered a clandestine counterfeiting operation in a garage in a neighborhood of Naples. The operation involved 31 professional printing machines used to produce counterfeit euros."

"🔹 This individual produced approximately €11 million in counterfeit banknotes. Of this amount, about €8 million entered the European economic system, and this individual alone was responsible for producing approximately 27% of the counterfeit euros discovered in Europe.
